question: PM Modi inaugurated Chenab Bridge, world’s highest rail arch bridge in ____________________.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• PM Modi inaugurates Chenab Bridge, world’s highest rail arch bridge in J&K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Chenab Bridge**, the world’s highest railway arch bridge (359 m above river), inaugurated by PM Modi in J&K.

 
 
• 
 
**Anji Bridge**, India’s first cable-stayed railway bridge, also inaugurated.

 
 
• 
 
**Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link (USBRL)** dedicated to the nation; 272 km long, includes 36 tunnels (119 km) and 943 bridges; cost approx ₹43,780 crore.

 
 
• 
 
These projects reduce travel time between Jammu and Srinagar by 2-3 hours and ensure all-weather connectivity.

 
 
• 
 
PM Modi flagged off **Vande Bharat Express** trains between Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra and Srinagar.

 
 
• 
 
Multiple road projects launched for better connectivity, including widening NH-701 and NH-444 and flyovers at Sangrama and Bemina junctions.

 
 
• 
 
Foundation stone laid for **Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Institute of Medical Excellence** in Katra (₹350 crore), first medical college in Reasi district.
